scope: Private WordPress research only; production Pages, branding, daily-source code and backend choice unchanged; no paid plan.
acceptedCode: c9ec130 / 17 patches / 62 TypeScript sources; exact normalized source comparison passed

fixedSixWrites.controls: Same owned draft, logged-in and warm, whole-response client timing; no CPU capture during benchmarks and sanitized tail in both variants.
fixedSixWrites.limits: Small sequential nonrandomized samples, network/time variation, growing owned revision history and slightly different paragraph bytes. The observed difference does not establish a stable end-to-end gain.

cpuProfile.limits: Sample total includes idle; not per-request CPU or a precise CPU/I/O split. No raw profile in Git.

candidateDesign: At most three immutable writes and 1 MiB queued source bytes; larger files write alone. One copied next file can coexist with the queue. Failures drain all active writes before rejecting; full manifest/restore pack and coordinator ordering retained.

focused.scope: Eight bounded-writer cases plus fifteen snapshot-source/restore cases.

preexistingFailures: Source-shape assertion is LF-specific while this Windows worker source has CRLF.
Source-shape assertion still expects previousRuntime.state; adopted lifetime fix uses previousRuntimeInfo.state.
Native php executable unavailable in this environment: spawn php ENOENT.
localValidation.note: Candidate files restored after baseline test via finally. These three failures are retained, not waived as an overall handoff pass. Runtime source is now the accepted 17-patch version.

cleanup.scope: Fresh-login exact content read after fixed comparisons, original homepage unchanged, identity-checked owned draft removal. Complete backup independently verifies no owned revisions remain.

integrity.scope: Complete backup after bounded write-latency comparisons and owned cleanup; all original content, historical revisions, media and metadata retained; owned draft/revisions absent

backup.scope: Authenticated remote R2 backup; every decoded entry verified; restore is a separate acceptance

observation.limits: Finite observation across serial and experimental versions. Event counts are not request counts; WASM/file-buffer totals are not whole-isolate memory. No lifetime reliability claim.

remaining: Native editing still takes multiple seconds; mobile/browser workflows and practical handoff remain incomplete.
Sustained free-tier usage and long-term reliability are not established.
No browser/mobile or separate empty-environment restore in this round.
